verdict: ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus: Choose ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus when published SMB/mid-market ITSM is the job — not ServiceNow by default, and not Freshservice by default. Scores use the IT & Development editorial methodology from first-party research as of 2026-08-18 — not hands-on product testing.
weaknesses: Does not outrank ServiceNow or Freshservice
AI is not the buying reason
bestFor: SMB/mid-market IT teams that want a published $13/technician ITSM SKU
Zoho/ManageEngine-aligned shops that need incidents, changes, and assets without a ServiceNow RFP
Buyers who will actually use the 5-tech free Standard path before paid Cloud
notIdealFor: Enterprises standardising on ServiceNow CMDB + ESM
Teams that want Freshservice’s simpler published mid-market UX as the default award path
tradeoffs: Per-agent vs per-host vs per-seat vs per-GB pricing models

Landscape-adjacent tools vs primary job-cluster peers on best pages
recommendation: Choose ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus when published SMB/mid-market ITSM is the job — not ServiceNow by default, and not Freshservice by default. Compare Freshservice for the published mid-market award path; Jira Service Management if you already live in Jira Cloud; ServiceNow for enterprise ESM.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Published Cloud Standard plus a 5-tech free path is approachable for SMB IT; less polished than Freshservice’s modern agent UX. Not a lab test.
ITSM / employee service desk — ranked with ServiceNow and Freshservice, not Datadog or GitHub. Held at 8 versus Freshservice’s 9.
Incident/problem/change/catalog/asset cover a real ITIL loop; edition gates keep it below ServiceNow CMDB estates.
Slack/Teams/Jira/API cover typical mid-market IT stacks — not ServiceNow’s enterprise graph.
Enterprise edition and Zoho/ManageEngine admin posture are adequate; not Now Platform domain separation.
Technician ladder to Enterprise $67; held at 7 versus ServiceNow global fulfiller scale.
Published $13 Standard plus free 5-tech path is the sharpest ITSM floor here. Affiliate economics excluded.
Zia/copilot-style ITSM assist exists — scored as supporting, not a reason to skip Freshservice Freddy or Now Assist.

overallScoreRationale: Weighted average of the eight IT editorial criteria using category weights (IT job fit 16, workflow depth 14, ease of use 12, integrations 12, admin/security 12, value 12, AI 12, scalability 10), rounded to 1 decimal. Products are scored inside their job cluster — ITSM, observability, source control, hosting panels, and web-data platforms are not forced into one undifferentiated ranking. Not a hands-on lab score, and affiliate economics are excluded.
